info.name: Arabian Commerce API - Ultimate Testing Flow
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for Arabian Commerce, featuring a Location-Based Delivery E-commerce system. Organised logically by Admin Panel and Customer App flows, with built-in scripts to auto-refresh Bearer tokens and track variables like Product IDs, Order IDs, and Address IDs.

item.name: 1. Admin Panel
item.description: Endpoints dedicated to Dashboard statistics, Delivery Zone settings, Product & Catalog controls, Inventory, and Order processing. Require Admin Bearer Token.

exec: console.log("Admin Token successfully captured and saved!");

request.description: Login endpoint for admins. Automatically captures JWT token and sets it as environment/collection variable `admin_token`.

Retrieve all delivery zones in the system.
Create a new location-based delivery zone. Automatically saves the resulting `delivery_zone_id`.

Update details of a delivery zone.
Remove a delivery zone from the system.
Fetch all products (both active and inactive) with custom pagination, filtering by category, search, or status.

item.name: 2. Customer App
item.description: Customer flows: Authentication via OTP, Profile information, Address management with location-based pricing, browsing active catalog items, managing Cart operations, and checking out Orders.

request.description: Step 1 of customer registration. Sends a verification OTP to the target phone number.

exec: console.log("Customer Token successfully captured and saved!");
